llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Gamma connector that uses OOMOL's oo CLI to list, inspect, and create Gamma generations with user-controlled payloads.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to operate Gamma through an OOMOL-connected account, and the artifact's actions are limited to Gamma generation creation, polling/status retrieval, and listing folders/themes.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs the agent to inspect live schemas before running actions and to confirm user intent before state-changing create actions; no hidden or unrelated instructions were found.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: First-time setup includes standard oo CLI install and auth steps, including shell installer commands, but they are disclosed and explicitly limited to cases where the command fails due to missing CLI or authentication.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The allowed tool scope is Bash(oo *), which is proportionate to an OOMOL connector skill and does not include arbitrary file indexing or unrelated local access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill relies on an OOMOL-connected Gamma account and server-side credential injection; this is sensitive integration behavior, but it is clearly disclosed and no background persistence, credential scraping, or token exposure is present.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this only if you are comfortable connecting Gamma through OOMOL and letting the agent create Gamma content when you approve the payload. Review create-generation requests before execution because they can change your Gamma workspace and may consume service credits.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector clean result] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues; artifact inspection was consistent with that result.
[VirusTotal clean telemetry] expected: VirusTotal reported no malicious or suspicious engines, and this was used only as supporting telemetry.
[Static scan clean result] expected: Static scan found no suspicious patterns; local review found only markdown instructions and no executable scripts.
